verdict.rationale: ADK's first-party docs say agents can 'swap the underlying intelligence' across Google and other providers through adapters, including locally running models. The agent definition takes the model as a single `model=` parameter, which supports swapping without rewriting agent logic. missing for 10: detailed docs naming specific provider adapters (e.g. which non-Google providers) and how to configure them, independent or hands-on corroboration that switching providers needs no other code changes.

support.subject: As a developer, I can swap the underlying LLM provider or model without rewriting my agent

citations.quote: Swap the underlying intelligence of your agents by integrating with generative AI models from Google and other providers.
we provide adapters that let you connect with many other models and model providers, including locally running models.
